info.name: Nyaay Saathi API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Nyaay Saathi Legal Platform

## Authentication
Most endpoints require Bearer token authentication. After login, the token is automatically saved to the `access_token` variable.

## Environment Variables Required
- `base_url`: API base URL (default: http://localhost:3000)
- `access_token`: JWT token (auto-populated after login)
- `refresh_token`: Refresh token (auto-populated after login)
- `razorpay_key_id`: Razorpay key for payments

## Quick Start
1. Import this collection
2. Import the environment file
3. Run 'Signup' or 'Signin' to get tokens
4. All authenticated requests will work automatically
